title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Can we donate organ? Will there be any problem in janazah, ghusl? Can a female also donate organ? 5650 views Q. I am a lecturer,I forgot my mobile at teacher table in class,the next teacher took it and told me that she will give me this mobile back after taking a fine of 500 Rupees or a party(drinking, eating). I told her that if I will give u a party, it will Haraam for you.she did not give mobile me back.After 2 days I took her mobile from her purse, so that I can get my own mobile from her.I asked her to give my mobile back and to take her from me. She put a complaint against me and said that I am a thief. Now plz guide me; 1. what sharia says about her doing when she took my mobile and did not give it me back? 2. Is it right for her to keep my mobile and take a prty, should I gave her a party? 3. If I give her party, without my happiness, just to take my mobile back,will it be Halaal for her or Haraam? 4.When after waiting 2 days, she did not give my mobile back, and I took her mobile from her purse, what is the order of sharia about me,? what is "KAFFAARA" I will have to pay if I am guilty? 5. People in daily life do like this, take any thing of a co worker, and then give him back after taking a party, what islamic sharia says about it? 2073 views Q. "In the name of Allah, the Compassionate, the Merciful" Asalamo Alykum, I once had plans to go abroad for studies. I did an Isthekhara for it. I saw my father crying over some mutual business partners' loss and somebody telling me that my father is already burnt. It was such a painful dream that I woke up with tears in my eyes. I gathered from it that my father has spent much on us and much of it is from Sood. So do not pressurize him for more expenditures so that he is forced to stick to Sood. I quit my plans for study abroad, and I have been trying for him to leave all Soodi investments. But when i think that the dream said "he is already burnt" i feel perhaps it is no use. The sin has amounted so much that Allah na karae, but he will burn in hell for sure. So I get disheartened. I also get disheartened because he has started taking out money from Soodi investments upon our insistence but he does not really consider it a sin. He says it is not that kind of forbidden Sood. So I wonder, even if he takes out all his soodi investment, if the remorse is not there, perhaps he will not be forgiven for lack of Tauba. How do you interpret the dream? 2520 views Q. What are the rights of parents over the income of married sons? 2962 views Q. question regarding TV 1766 views Q. What does Shariah say about someone's left behind things? 2427 views Q. Is it permissible to sell human bones for medical studies nd if not dn wht shud a person do wid the bones already present. 2441 views Q. Giving shop on security 2205 views Q. custom 1396 views Q. My YOUNGER brother is the officer in the bank he is MBA in finance. I am engineer and we live in joint family, our household expences are born by contribution by both. Shall i continue with him or stay away as his income is based on intrest. (1) Can i eat any things offred by him or not. 2299 views Q. Assalamualikum Mufti Sb., I want to know for the following, whether i am doing right or wrong. Actualy my boss/manager allotted to me some work in our office. I am highly expert doing this job but my manager is little bit know. I don't want to share this information to my manager (i.e. i am highly expert in this job). If the same job my manager will do, he will take 3 days to complete the same. If I will do this job then Insha Allah I will be finished within 2 to 3 hours). As I told already I don't want to share this technique to my manager, when I am doing this job, my manager is coming frequently and asking me what is the status but I am always(till 3 days) not yet finished (actually i have finised 1st day (within 3 hours) itself. MY QUESTION IS WHETHER I AM DOING CORRECT OR NOT. (I WAS LISTIONED ONE HADITH, Prophet (صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم SAID THAT U DON'T WANT TO SHARE YOUR BUSINESS SECRET TO YOUR BROTHER ALSO) 1927 views Q. What are the Islamic rulings on marital intimacy, ingesting breast milk, and the necessity of ghusl after physical contact? 122872 views Q. I am a married and Muslim man Praying five times every day. I have a question which I can not ask form any Alim face to face I hope my question will be answered Jazakallah Khair!! My question is when I share bed (Have sex) with my wife how much naked we both can be as per Islamic law whole body or some part please answer my question in the light of Shariah so as to get me out of confusion thank You very much 4082 views Q. Allah has made me a software engineer by profession.Currently working in a reputed software company in India. I want to leave this company and start my own work as I do not feel my Iman each time so strong that I may be able to violate the cultures of the company which are not according to sharia like wearing pent shirt, Answering greetings of Na Maharam.Also things like the mendatory insurance component in the salary which I do not want to subscribe for, still deducted from my salary. In short these and some other things inspire me to start my own job.My parents have taken loan from bank.The loan includes interest terms also..Allah helps them to repay the loan via me.(However I am not the only source but Allah has made me as a major contributor towards repayment of the loan). Is this okay If I ask My parents to give me few months (2-3) to collect money by the salary instead of giving them and made investment in new work? However I have talked already to my parents about it that this new work may require some investment of a good portion of 2-3 months salary and they have given there consent. So the first question is what is better?Should I continue to work in the company and made small investments towards the own work (Which I feel a long process). Or go with the instant investment by putting the portion of salary towards new job which Allah gives currently to my parents via me.Ofcaurse success will be there only if Allah wills. My second question is regarding the new work I wants to start. InshaAllah it will be website based work initially. The plan is to provide a internet based facility to people where people can learn by there and other people's learnings. Learning means any learning what people may put on the website.Hence this learning can be according to sharia and opposite to sharia also. Like one people my place his/her learning as "Speak truth even in tough situation" and another one may place his learning as "Alcohol is good for health".So people may read both wrong and right learnings also.In addition the learnings can be of any other type also like business learning etc. Its like an opinion of someone by his/her experience. So the second question is such service/website allowed. The third question is about charging the people who use this service. Someone may be allowed to pay amount(as a fees of using this website) if He/She feels that he/she has benefitted via this website. So its upto that "Somebody" whether he wants to pay for the use website or not. Is such earning halal,(Please let me know even if its halal but undesirable)? Also should I set a maximum amount which a person can pay if he/she wills to pay? Please consider the use of this website for business organizations also where it becomes obligatory chargable. 3091 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 155940 Country: India Title: Can I see the videos of Islamic scholars like Tariq Jameel sb., Mufti Taqi Usmani sb. etc? Question: Can I see the videos of Islamic scholars like Tariq Jameel sb., Mufti Taqi Usmani sb. etc? Answer ID: 155940 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 156/104/SD=2/1439) According to Shariah, it is not lawful to watch videos that contain pictures. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
